text:
Yoshi and the Mysterious Book Demo Debuts
We can now try Yoshi and the Mysterious Book with a demo before buying it, with saves carrying over.

author: Siliconera
text:
Palworld Price Won’t Go Up Alongside 1.0 Full Release
To thank players and celebrate the success of Palworld, the price will not change following the 1.0 patch launch.

author: Siliconera
text:
New Gundam Anime Series and Game Head to SDCC 2026
The new Gundam anime series will be revealed at a SDCC 2026 panel and YouTube stream later this month.

author: Siliconera
text:
Animal Crossing Personal Marker Charms Appear in August
A set of Animal Crossing personal marker charms of characters that can connect to each other will debut in Japan next month.

author: Siliconera
text:
Mario Kart Tour Mobile Game Shuts Down in September
The Nintendo mobile game Mario Kart Tour will end in 2026, but there'll be some Gold Pass benefits for everyone before that.

author: Siliconera
text:
Review: Echoes of Aincrad Has Pacing Issues
Echoes of Aincrad could have been a fun take on the world of Sword Art Online, if not for its pacing and padding issues.

author: Siliconera
text:
Nintendo SDCC 2026 Booth Games Teased
The Nintendo SDCC 2026 game events will include Splatoon Raiders at a booth and Nintendo Switch Sports Resort at a nearby hotel.

author: Siliconera
text:
Transformers Gigawatt Turns Into Back to the Future DeLorean
The action figure will appear with a 40th anniversary version package in late December 2026.

author: Siliconera
text:
Noto Satoyama Pokemon With You Airport Now Open
Only for a limited time until September 2029.

author: Siliconera
text:
Before Crisis Joins FFVII Ever Crisis Before Shutdown
We'll get a three-chapter Before Crisis Final Fantasy VII story in FFVII Ever Crisis before it will be shutdown later this year.

author: Siliconera
text:
Love and Deepspace Bilibili World 2026 Booth Canceled
They didn't expressly say the reason, but yeah, it's because of him.

text:
Fields of Mistria Engine Migration Patch Affects Mod Compatibility
The new Fields of Mistria patch involves the new game engine and affects compatibility for existing mods from the last one.

text:
Bath Bombs Pair Pokemon Up With Ditto
Pikachu, Eevee, and the 9th-generation starters will enter the bath in August 2026.

text:
Silent Hill: The Short Message Getting PS5 Physical Release
PS5 physical copies of Silent Hill: The Short Message will only be available via a Limited Run Games Deluxe Edition.

text:
New Pokemon Lego Sets Include Red, Rayquaza, and Oak’s Lab
The new Lego Pokemon sets involve Arcanine, Munchlax, Rayquaza, Red, and an Iconic Trainer Moments Poke Ball with Oak's Lab inside.
